description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the MessageTap class, verifying its behavior in handling messages and consumers within the org.eclipse.hono.util package.

classes.name: MessageTapTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of the MessageTap utility class, focusing on message consumption and notification handling.

methods.name: testTapCallsMessageConsumer
methods.description: Verifies that the MessageTap's consumer correctly calls the message consumer when a message is accepted.

methods.name: testTapCallsNotificationDeviceReadyToDeliverConsumer
methods.description: Ensures that both the message consumer and notification consumer are called when a message indicates command readiness via time-to-disconnect.

methods.name: testTapCallsNotificationDeviceReadyToDeliverConsumerForEmptyEvent
methods.description: Checks that notification and message consumers are called even when the message body is empty, indicating command readiness.

methods.name: createTestMessage
methods.description: Helper method to create a test Message with optional content type and payload, setting relevant message properties.

methods.name: createTestMessageWithoutBody
methods.description: Helper method to create a Message without setting its body, initializing message properties.
